reason: I already have my Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Single foil sachets also feel like a lot of extra packaging for something I can take from a bottle.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a brand I reorder without thinking.
would_change_my_mind: If my current brand got worse or more expensive, and this one came in recyclable packaging with a clearly lower price per day.
